zh.title: 澳洲航空、英國航空調整A380客艙配置並削減經濟艙座位
zh.summary: 澳洲航空與英國航空調整A380客艙，削減經濟艙座位
body: Simple Flying 報導，澳洲航空正在重新規劃一架總座位數為485的空中巴士 A380 客艙配置；英國航空則將從 A380 移除88個經濟艙座位。報導摘要表示，兩家航空公司都在調整 A380 客艙，以減少經濟艙座位。
兩項調整涉及不同航空公司的客艙配置。澳洲航空的485席數字指向該架飛機的座位配置；英國航空的88席數字則是將移除的經濟艙座位數。報導所述的共同點是，兩家航空公司都在重新配置 A380 的經濟艙座位。

en.title: Qantas and British Airways Adjust A380 Cabin Layouts
en.summary: Qantas and British Airways reconfigure A380 cabins, reducing economy seating.
body: Simple Flying reports two Airbus A380 cabin changes. Qantas is reworking the floor plan of a 485-seat A380, while British Airways is removing 88 economy seats. The summary says both airlines are reconfiguring their A380s to reduce economy seating. The stated 485-seat figure describes Qantas’s aircraft layout; the 88-seat figure refers specifically to the economy seats British Airways is removing.

The adjustments concern the cabin layouts of the two airlines’ A380s. Qantas’s stated change is a reworking of its 485-seat floor plan; British Airways’s is the removal of 88 economy seats. The report’s summary characterizes both changes as reconfigurations intended to reduce economy seating.
